source_cohort.source_dataset: IIPS Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI) Wave 1 (2017-2019)
source_cohort.scope_note: LASI Wave 1 provides real Indian adult anthropometry, demographics, physical activity, and prevalent Diabetes/Obesity/CVD status for Stage 2-4 meal planning and conversational revision benchmarking. It lacks serum lipids and 24-hour dietary nutrient recalls, so it is NOT used to claim external validation of the 87-feature Stage 1 NHANES Transformer.
